conviction_note: The H1 operating profit will probably miss the company's own H1 plan of ¥15.0bn by about 4-8%, but the 月次 have shown that for weeks and the IFIS consensus already sits 3.3% below the full-year plan. So the print turns on the full-year forecast decision, which my evidence leaves roughly balanced: the company held at H1 in 2025 and has not cut in three years, against an H2 that would need +18% OP to make ¥29.4bn. The name has sold three of its last four prints, including beats, on a 11x 信用倍率, and that leaves a slight negative lean (p_up 47) on a scale of 5.5%. impact_sum -0.3 and impact_scaled -0.33 agree.
bar: H1 (Mar-Aug) operating profit ¥15,000m company plan (kabutan 半期予想, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2726), my estimate ~¥13.9-14.3bn, so roughly -5% against the plan. The market's own bar is the IFIS consensus for FY2027/2: sales ¥248.7bn, OP ¥28,433m, 経常 ¥28,417m (cut from ¥28,717m four weeks earlier), against the company plan of ¥253.0bn / ¥29,400m (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2726). IFIS publishes no H1 consensus, so the H1 number is measured against the company plan and the FY decision against IFIS.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (none disclosed at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 11.04x (baseline; kabutan shows the same 11.04x on 2026-10-06, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2726): margin long is crowded and there is no short fuel. findings.finding: H1 sales are visible from the company's own 月次 at 全店 104.0% YoY (Q2: Jun 100.1, Jul 108.2, Aug 103.2), against an H1 plan of ¥126.0bn (+7.6%). Q1 OP was only +1.3% (¥7,953m), so Q2 OP would need ¥7,047m (+12.9% YoY) to reach the ¥15.0bn H1 plan. That is implausible with Aug store comps at 97.8% and 雑貨 below last year, so H1 OP lands near ¥13.9-14.3bn, a miss of about 5% against the plan and the first H1 miss against plan in the four years on record.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-07: OP +1.3% (a thin increase), stock -5.0% next day (kabutan/fisco 2026-07-08). H1 2025-10-07: OP 11% above the H1 plan, stock -8.1% next day. The quarter line has been sold whichever way it went.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 月次 are public, the stock fell 3.3% on the August release day, and IFIS cut its FY 経常 consensus from ¥28,717m to ¥28,417m over the last four weeks. What is left is the margin: Q2 SG&A pressure from wage rises (named at Q1) and weaker 雑貨 mix are not in the 月次. The 11x 信用倍率 is the one setup where a visible miss still has sellers, so this keeps a small negative.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 numbers via kabutan finance (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2726) and the fisco note on rising SG&A ratio (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2726&b=n202607080450). Different documents, same company line.

findings.finding: The full-year decision is the real event. Holding the ¥29,400m OP plan implies H2 OP of about ¥15.1-15.5bn against ¥13,049m last year (+16-19%), and the street already sits at ¥28,433m (IFIS, 5 analysts, all rated 強気). The company's revision record over three years has no cut: it raised at H1 in Oct 2023 and Oct 2024, held at H1 in Oct 2025 despite an 11% H1 beat, and finished above plan. So a hold is a relief against the street bar, a trim to about ¥28.4bn is neutral, and only a cut below consensus is new bad news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-07, a first FY guide of +8.3% OP: +7.1% next day, given back the following day (kabutan 2026-04-08). 2025-10-07, FY held after an H1 beat: -8.1%. No forecast cut on record to read.
findings.why_not_priced: The market has to price a decision that has not been made. If it were fully priced, the stock would be indifferent between a hold and a trim to consensus. At 12.9x company EPS, against an average analyst target of ¥2,030 and a fall from about ¥2,300 a year ago, it is priced for the cut rather than for the hold. The company's no-cut habit is the part a holder fearing a cut may be underweighting.
findings.independence: Revision history also on https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2726, which shows the 修正 dates. The same underlying company filings.

findings.finding: Peer read-through for the H2 narrative: アンドST (Adastria, same young-casual apparel segment and FY) reported September comps +8.8% on cool weather and strong autumn apparel (+2.1pt calendar), and United Arrows' comps rose for a 12th straight month in September. PAL's own August release says the H2 plan rests on new 雑貨 products, with headcount for them already added. That supports management holding the FY plan at this release; PAL's own September 月次 is not out until 10/26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none for a peer read-through; Adastria itself fell on its H1 (+35% OP, FY held) on 2026-10-01
findings.why_not_priced: A proxy: PAL's September is unpublished, and roughly half of PAL's sales are 3COINS 雑貨, where a cool September does not obviously help seasonal goods. That makes it small. If it were priced, PAL would have bounced with Adastria's +3-day rebound on 10/05; PAL closed 1,411 against 1,399, flat.
findings.independence: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7606&b=n202610050532 (United Arrows September comps), a different issuer

findings.finding: Reaction function and positioning: PAL fell after three of its last four prints, including clear beats: -8.1% on 2025-10-08 after an 11% H1 OP beat, -9.1% on 2026-01-14 after Q3 経常 +14% and a dividend raise, and -5.0% on 2026-07-08. The peer Adastria fell on a +35% H1 OP beat on 2026-10-01. The 信用倍率 is 11.04x with no disclosed shorts, so nothing on the short side can squeeze.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly in the baseline lean already (margin_overhang -0.52), so it is sized small. It is filed because the habit of selling beats sets the reaction to a held guide: a hold may not lift the stock the way the street bar suggests.
findings.independence: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2726&b=n202510080371 (fisco on the Oct 2025 sell-off, 出尽くし). Same events, a different source.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible and the main event. The FY plan needs H2 OP +16-19%, the street is 3.3% below the plan, and the company has not cut in 3 years. Returns: not expected (the buyback ended 08-31, no interim dividend, no Q2 return announcement last year). New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter: Q1 progress was 53.0% of the H1 plan against 55.8% and 53.7% in the prior two years, and H1 will likely reach about 46-48% of the FY OP plan against 53.3% last year.
baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, in line with the baseline's margin-overhang lean (-0.31) and the -4.2% run-up, so they mostly agree with what is priced. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY forecast, which matches the company's three-year habit and sits above a street that has already marked it down; I looked for a buyback or a dividend change and found neither likely.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次): finding 1, the H1 miss against plan, shrunk from -0.8 to -0.4, and p_up moved from 45 to 47

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive, a held FY forecast against a consensus already below plan, is written into baseline_tension; I had already looked for returns (none likely), so it moved no number beyond the p_up move above
Findings 2, 3 and 4 left standing; abs_move_pct unchanged at 5.5
